coordinate_rule: Both source GLB vertex buffers are already metres. Cadgen occurrence transforms are row-major millimetres: convert only the translation column to metres, then transpose for glTF column-major matrix. Never use the WP06 world-coordinate STEP identity matrix for cached local component vertices.
identity_rule: Old GLB extras.instance_id exactly matches all 585 W4 SERVICE scene IDs. Replacement/addition lookup uses W6 assembly.json occurrences.name and component. Preserve all 573 unchanged node records and the original binary payload byte-for-byte; remove four nodes and append 16. Final visible IDs must exactly equal 597 INTEGRATION_MANIFEST SERVICE IDs.
verification_scope: Actual POSITION vertices are measured in bounded NumPy chunks after output readback. World AABBs compared per instance with the integration manifest using inherited W4 <2 mm display-only tolerance. This is not STEP/BRep equivalence, contact clearance, global collision, continuous-motion, physical-assembly, thread, strength or manufacturing evidence.
runtime: Root runs tools/build_review_glb.py --state service serially. No CAD/COM is imported. Outputs are new viewer/WP07_SERVICE_REVIEW.glb, REVIEW_GLB_INPUT_SNAPSHOT.json and REVIEW_GLB_RESULT.json; existing outputs are never overwritten.
snapshot_route: The installed CAD snapshot CLI accepts direct GLB and its resolve_mesh_render_job bypasses the STEP artifact pipeline. Use the produced new GLB as the input. Mesh mode is shaded solid; STEP topology selectors and exploded mode are not available. Never reuse an old image as new-model evidence.
